dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: H-hold up! I can barely keep up with you guys.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Eh, get longer legs I guess.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: I don't think we have enough time to relay the message to everyone at this rate.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: Especially if we want to be able to send a message back out to the humans in a timely manner.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: We're only performing for a fraction of the colony's workforce.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: It might be beneficial for us to invest in a station for our operations.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: A base. Somewhere where we can lay low and come up with a plan to enact Project Overture-

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Oh! I can look ahead then! I'll relay what I find to Trill!

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: It's just like before we started this whole operation! BRB!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Perfect! Once Chromatic finds us a nice place, we can get set up and start talking strategy.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Until then, let's keep up this energy!

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: But Chromatic had all of the energy...
